dirt_catalog_signal: BBlues Overdrive Pro; G-2 Distortion; Delicate; Delicate 2; G4 Metal Gate
relationship_notes: Thai boutique pedal maker founded by Songpol Teeramanud in 2008. First-party Pedal Tank material identifies a Thailand office and current effects including G2V5 Distortion and ZenTro Overdrive; Effects Database documents the hand-built BBlues and Delicate 2 lines. Preserve Delicate/Delicate 2 and G2/G2V5 naming as chronology clues rather than assuming identical generations. G4 Metal Gate is retained as a lower-confidence catalog signal until stronger primary documentation is found.

Philippine builder associated with Mark V and the M.V. Electronics Shredhead. Multiple sources document hand-built, numbered/signed units, the original Shredhead and later limited-edition Devastator state, plus ongoing used-market traces. Keep Mark V as builder attribution and M.V. Electronics as commercial name until a primary-source identity record resolves the naming relationship.

dirt_catalog_signal: The Winter; The Winter V2; Cold Lands; Astronaut; Astronaut V2; Green100; Vintage Modern; Monolith; Dark Ages; Silencer; The Forest; Damage Control; Hybrid Machine
relationship_notes: Taiwan-based boutique builder founded by a French musician in 2017. Current first-party store and retailer pages establish an active catalog including Monolith, Dark Ages, Silencer, The Forest, Cold Lands, The Winter V2 and Astronaut V2. Historical FXDB material documents earlier The Winter, Astronaut, Hybrid Machine and Green100 development. Preserve V2 names and historical model transitions for Protocol B.

dirt_catalog_signal: Centurion; Taroko Gorge; Grand Hotel; Samurai; rotary-phone custom effects
relationship_notes: Small Taipei custom shop operated by builder David. Effects Database documents a hand-built limited-run catalog including Centurion Professional Drive, Taroko Gorge Professional Distortion, Grand Hotel Professional Pre-Amp and Samurai Professional Boost. 2026 reporting documents additional custom pedals built from vintage telephones, including Rotary Phone 027 Secret Agent. Treat object-based/custom releases separately from stable named catalog models and do not infer all one-off units are part of a fixed series.

dirt_catalog_signal: MangoJuice; Pixie; Fudge 73; Seventheaven / 7thvn; Kult; Blitzkrieg; Boosty; Noizetherapy
relationship_notes: Singapore one-man operation by Ravi Goose, active from 2002 and strongly documented through Effects Database interviews and catalog records. The maker produced original gain/fuzz designs as well as clearly identified clone-derived work such as Fudge 73. Later sources indicate the brand's active period was mainly in the 2010s and that it became difficult to source. Archive as a historical Singapore builder with strong specimen and chronology value, not as a confirmed currently active manufacturer.
